description: Reviewed Ancient Greek adverbs in -ως that stay their own headword although an adjective of the same stem exists. build/build_grc_adverb_heads.py leaves every entry out of data/grc_adverb_heads.json and lists it there as `keep`; at runtime an ADV-tagged keep word is returned as itself instead of the POS table's adjective. Every entry has a reason. Corpus evidence is from data/diorisis_pairs.json and data/perseus_pairs.json (the AGDT).

entries.reason: adverb of the pronominal adjective μόνος ('only, alone'); Diorisis and the AGDT lemmatize it as itself
adverb of the ordinal πρῶτος ('for the first time') with its own LSJ entry; Diorisis and the AGDT lemmatize it as itself
temporal correlative of ἕως ('meanwhile'), not the adverb of an adjective; own LSJ and Cunliffe entry; Diorisis and the AGDT lemmatize it as itself
pronominal adverb ('somehow', ἀμῶς γέ πως) of the indefinite ἀμός, which survives only in such adverbs; Diorisis lemmatizes it as itself
pronominal adverb of ἄλλος, 'otherwise, in vain', with its own LSJ and Cunliffe entry; Diorisis and the AGDT lemmatize it as itself
pronominal adverb of ἕτερος with its own Cunliffe entry; Diorisis and the AGDT lemmatize it as itself
the ag_gold and katharevousa_gold gate fixtures lemmatize it as itself (lexicalized 'especially, properly'); Diorisis and the AGDT give ἴδιος, so it is kept to follow the fixtures
lexicalized as 'perhaps', no longer read as 'equally' from ἴσος; the ag_gold fixture, Diorisis and the AGDT lemmatize it as itself
'equally, together', of the pronominal ὁμός, with its own LSJ and Cunliffe entry; Diorisis and the AGDT lemmatize it as itself, and it must stay apart from ὅμως
